items.title: Worthia "Showboy" Thomas Interview, 1961-12-11
items.q: Well, there was Chumbone, Alto trumpet, drums, James Grant on piano.

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. Called Sporting Boots. Yeah. I knew, well, I heard, let's see, Boots is the Austin Young, the bass player. Right, right. I even made some records with him way back. He was a great drummer. Ten years or so ago. At that time. Yeah. And told me he lost his teeth and he took up bass. I only took him on bass. Right. I heard his brother once at the taxi dance hall someplace. La Vida. One of those places someplace. And I never did really get to know it. Wow. His name was Willie Young. Called him Sporting.

He was a great musician. Well, he was in the band with Robert Taylor. Well, there was Chumbone, Alto trumpet, drums, James Grant on piano. They never did have a bass. Yeah. James Grant was a piano player. He's from here. He was from up on Valence and Magnolia at that time. And he was a fella who played plenty of piano. And he also played axelophon.
Did the sport, the young play clarinet or sax all the time? In late years you only played alto sax?
